```{r}
# ---- reusable gt theme ----
theme_gt <- function(x) {
  x |>
    opt_row_striping() |>
    fmt_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "") |>
    tab_options(
      table.width = pct(100),
      data_row.padding = px(4),
      table.font.size = px(12),
      heading.align = "left"
    )
}

current_date <- Sys.Date()

# ---- controlled vocabularies ----
record_type_levels <- c(
  "method_paper",
  "software_paper",
  "software_record",
  "validation_comparison",
  "preprint_method",
  "application_only",
  "background_only"
)

workflow_stage_levels <- c(
  "digitization_frontend",
  "reconstruction_core",
  "subgroup_recovery",
  "end_to_end_pipeline",
  "benchmark_validation",
  "background_context"
)

automation_levels <- c(
  "manual",
  "semi_automated",
  "fully_automated"
)

dedup_levels <- c(
  "unique",
  "exact_duplicate",
  "near_duplicate"
)

ta_decision_levels <- c(
  "include",
  "exclude",
  "unclear"
)

ft_decision_levels <- c(
  "include_main_review",
  "include_background_only",
  "exclude",
  "awaiting"
)

judgement_levels <- c(
  "Low concerns",
  "Some concerns",
  "High concerns",
  "Not reported"
)



screening_reason_codebook <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Stage, ~ReasonCode, ~ReasonLabel,
  "TA", "not_km_ipd", "Not about KM-based IPD reconstruction",
  "TA", "hr_only_no_ipd", "Extracts HR or other aggregate statistics only; no IPD reconstruction",
  "TA", "application_only", "Clinical/application paper only; no new method, software, or validation",
  "TA", "abstract_only", "Conference abstract with insufficient technical detail",
  "TA", "unrelated_software", "General survival-analysis software unrelated to KM -> IPD reconstruction",
  "TA", "duplicate", "Duplicate or near-duplicate record",

  "FT", "application_only", "Uses reconstructed IPD but does not develop, implement, or validate a method",
  "FT", "insufficient_method_detail", "Method/software insufficiently described for appraisal",
  "FT", "background_only", "Relevant for historical context only, not for main review",
  "FT", "fulltext_unavailable", "Full text unavailable after reasonable retrieval attempts",
  "FT", "duplicate_report", "Duplicate / superseded / companion report",
  "FT", "not_methodological", "Not a methodological, software, or validation record"
)

metric_codebook <- tibble::tribble(
  ~MetricCode, ~MetricLabel, ~Direction, ~Unit,
  "hr_apd", "Absolute percentage difference in hazard ratio", "lower_better", "percent",
  "ci_nonoverlap", "95% CI non-overlap", "lower_better", "percent",
  "rmse_surv", "RMSE of survival probabilities", "lower_better", "probability",
  "mae_surv", "Mean absolute error of survival probabilities", "lower_better", "probability",
  "maxae_surv", "Maximum absolute error of survival probabilities", "lower_better", "probability",
  "ks_test", "Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic / test", "lower_better", "test/statistic",
  "kendall_tau", "Kendall's tau", "higher_better", "correlation",
  "success_rate", "Task success rate", "higher_better", "proportion",
  "runtime", "Runtime", "lower_better", "time",
  "manual_burden", "Manual preprocessing burden", "lower_better", "ordinal"
)

failure_mode_codebook <- tibble::tribble(
  ~FailureCode, ~FailureLabel,
  "low_resolution", "Low-resolution image",
  "overlapping_curves", "Overlapping or same-color curves",
  "missing_risk_table", "Missing numbers-at-risk table",
  "missing_total_events", "Missing total event count",
  "unclear_censor_marks", "Unclear or absent censoring marks",
  "rotated_axes", "Rotated or skewed axes",
  "ocr_failure", "OCR or text-detection failure",
  "manual_preprocessing_dependency", "Strong dependency on manual preprocessing",
  "poor_curve_separation", "Poor separation of multiple treatment arms",
  "non_reproducible_pipeline", "Preprocessing not fully reproducible"
)
```

```{r}
search_log <- tibble::tribble(
  ~ID,      ~Source,   ~Date,        ~Status,     ~Query_Type, ~Exact_Query, ~Limits, ~Hits, ~ScreenedTopN, ~Notes,

  "PM-001", "PubMed",  current_date, "executed",  "Concept",
  '(("Kaplan-Meier"[Title/Abstract] OR "Kaplan Meier"[Title/Abstract] OR "KM curve*"[Title/Abstract] OR "KM plot*"[Title/Abstract] OR "survival curve*"[Title/Abstract]) AND (reconstruct*[Title/Abstract] OR recover*[Title/Abstract] OR digitiz*[Title/Abstract] OR extract*[Title/Abstract]) AND (algorithm[Title/Abstract] OR methodology[Title/Abstract] OR validation[Title/Abstract] OR comparison[Title/Abstract] OR "simulation study"[Title/Abstract] OR performance[Title/Abstract] OR accuracy[Title/Abstract])) NOT ("systematic review"[Title] OR "meta-analysis"[Title] OR treatment[Title] OR efficacy[Title] OR "clinical trial"[Title])',
  "2012-present", 11, 11,
  "Primary concept-based search for KM reconstruction methodology",

  "PM-002", "PubMed",  current_date, "executed", "Entity/tool",
  '("IPDfromKM"[Title/Abstract] OR "ipdfc"[Title/Abstract] OR "SurvdigitizeR"[Title/Abstract] OR "KMSubtraction"[Title/Abstract] OR "reconstructKM"[Title/Abstract] OR "KM-GPT"[Title/Abstract] OR "getIPD"[Title/Abstract])',
  "2012-present", 6, 6,
  "Retrieve known methods, software, and named workflows",

  "AX-001", "arXiv", current_date, "executed", "Concept",
  '"IPD reconstruction" OR "Kaplan-Meier reconstruction"',
  "2012-present", 6, 6,
  "Supplementary preprint search for recent method papers",

  "AX-002", "arXiv", current_date, "executed", "Concept",
  '"KM curve digitize" OR "survival curve digitization"',
  "2012-present", 31, 6,
  "Supplementary preprint/automation search; screened only top results",

  "GS-001", "Google Scholar", current_date, "executed", "Concept",
  '"Kaplan-Meier" "individual patient data" reconstruction',
  "2012-present", 293, 50,
  "-meta -review -systematic -clinical -trial -oncology -network -cost -effectiveness",

  "GS-002", "Google Scholar", current_date, "executed", "Concept",
  '"published Kaplan-Meier curves" "individual patient data"',
  "2012-present", 2290, 50,
  "-meta -review -systematic -clinical -trial -oncology -network -cost -effectiveness",

  "GS-003", "Google Scholar", current_date, "executed", "Entity/tool",
  '"IPDfromKM" OR "SurvdigitizeR" OR "ipdfc" OR "KMSubtraction" OR "KM-GPT" OR "reconstructKM"',
  "2012-present", 952, 50,
  "Supplementary exact-name search for known methods and software",

  "CRAN-001", "CRAN", current_date, "executed", "Entity/tool",
  '"IPDfromKM" OR "reconstructKM"',
  "Current snapshot", 2, 2,
  "Software registry search for R packages",


)

search_log |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Search Log**"),
    subtitle = "Concise view for manuscript drafting"
  ) |>
  cols_label(
    ID = "Search ID",
    Source = "Source",
    Date = "Date",
    Status = "Status",
    Query_Type = "Type",
    Exact_Query = "Search keywords query",
    Limits = "Limits",
    Hits = "Hits",
    ScreenedTopN = "Top N screened",
    Notes = "Notes"
  ) |>
  fmt_date(
    columns = Date,
    date_style = "iso"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(Hits, ScreenedTopN),
    decimals = 0
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(
      size = px(10),  
      font = "Courier New" 
    ),
    locations = cells_body(columns = Exact_Query)
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(ID, Date, Status, Query_Type, Hits, ScreenedTopN)
  ) |>
  cols_width(
    ID ~ px(85),
    Source ~ px(80),
    Date ~ px(95),
    Status ~ px(80),
    Query_Type ~ px(85),
    Exact_Query ~ px(320),
    Limits ~ px(110),
    Hits ~ px(60),
    ScreenedTopN ~ px(95),
    Notes ~ px(220)
  ) |>
  theme_gt()
```
